title: Typed local API and live event stream
description: Fastify routes for every Core read (rows, runs, cards, spend, events) and write (answer a card, approve, kill, resume); OpenAPI and a TypeScript client generated from the contracts; an SSE stream resumable by seq; loopback bind with an Origin check; no business logic in routes.
acceptance: Every route is exercised by a contract test through the generated client
The SSE stream resumes from Last-Event-ID without gaps or duplicates
A request from a non-loopback origin, or without the session token, gets 401 or 403
